Module cave_hold "A cave hold" {
  Description "A cave in a hillside behind a screen of brambles: a mouth where the watch sits, a smoky cavern, a ledge up a notched log where the chief sleeps, a pit for captives, a dry side-cave for plunder, a crack that looks out over the road, and a chimney that comes out on the hillside above.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place land "The region" is region.
  Place outside "The approach" is room.

  Place lair "the cave" is site within land.
  Place mouth "the cave mouth" is room within lair at 0, 1.
  Place cavern "the smoky cavern" is room within lair at 1, 1.
  Place ledge "the high ledge" is room within lair at 1, 0.
  Place pit "the captives' pit" is room within lair at 2, 1.
  Place cache "a dry side-cave" is room within lair at 2, 0.
  Place crack "the spy-crack" is room within lair at 0, 0.
  Place hillside "the hillside above the cave" is room within lair at 1, 2.
  Initially Assert unlit(pit). Initially Assert unlit(cache). Initially Assert unlit(crack). Initially Assert indoors(cavern).

  Passage brambles "the brambles across the cave mouth" is passage between outside and mouth taking 10 minutes.
  Passage cave_throat "the throat of the cave" is passage between mouth and cavern.
  Passage notched_log "a notched log up to the ledge" is climb between cavern and ledge.
  Passage pit_rope "a rope ladder down into the pit" is climb between cavern and pit.
  Passage cache_crawl "a crawl into the side-cave" is crawl between cavern and cache.
  Passage crack_way "a cleft in the wall" is passage between mouth and crack.
  Passage chimney "the chimney" is climb between cavern and hillside taking 30 minutes hidden until backway_known needing climbing or rope.
  Passage hill_path "a goat-track down the hillside" is path between hillside and outside taking 20 minutes.

  Observe mouth_scene at mouth when true "The cave mouth, behind its brambles: a fire-blackened ceiling, gnawed bones, and a stool for whoever keeps watch.".
  Observe cavern_scene at cavern when true "A big smoky cavern with a fire in the middle and the smoke going up into a black hole in the roof. A notched log leans against the wall up to a ledge; a rope ladder hangs into a pit.".
  Observe ledge_scene at ledge when true "A ledge high in the cavern wall, out of the smoke: a bed of skins, and a chest.".
  Observe pit_scene at pit when true "A pit with sheer sides and a muck floor. You would not climb out of it without the rope.".
  Observe cache_scene at cache when true "A dry side-cave stacked with plunder.".
  Observe crack_scene at crack when true "A cleft in the rock that looks straight down on the road below.".
  Observe hillside_scene at hillside when true "The open hillside above the cave. Smoke comes out of a hole among the rocks.".
  Observe chimney_hint at cavern when not knows(party, backway_known) "The smoke goes up the hole in the roof as if it had somewhere to go.".

  Thing chest "a chest on the ledge" at ledge {
    Holds.
    State locked closed "A chest stands on the ledge, locked.".
    State open "The chest on the ledge stands open.".
    Change pick "Pick the chest's lock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change smash "Break the chest open" from locked to open needing brawn.
  }
  Thing heap "a heap of plunder" at cache {
    Holds.
  }
  Discovery backway_known "The smoke-hole in the cave's roof is a chimney that comes out on the hillside above; a climber could go up or down it." {
    Found by searching cavern "Up the smoke-hole there is daylight, and a crack worn by hands and feet: a chimney, and someone climbs it.".
    Found by searching outside with woodcraft "Up the hillside, smoke comes out of a hole among the rocks, and there is a goat-track to it.".
  }
  Goal false.
}

Module brackenholt "Brackenholt and the holt" {
  Description "The east bank of the Serewater: Brackenholt, a woodcutters' village under an old watchtower, and the holt of bracken and oak between it and the downs. Wren's ferry crosses from Reedwake; the long way round passes a bears' den.".

  Place march "The region" is region.
  Place quay "Reedwake quay" is room.

  Passage ferry_crossing "Wren's ferry" is ferry between quay and landing taking 30 minutes.
  Passage landing_lane "the landing lane" is path between landing and holt_green.
  Passage holly_door "the Holly Bush door" is door between holly_room and holt_green.
  Passage holt_west "the holt way down from the downs" is path between cross_green and holt_edge taking 1 hour.
  Passage holt_mid "the holt way through the bracken" is path between holt_edge and den_clearing taking 30 minutes.
  Passage holt_east "the holt way into Brackenholt" is path between den_clearing and holt_green taking 1 hour.
  Passage tower_lane "the lane up to the tower" is track between holt_green and tower_foot taking 30 minutes.
  Passage lychgate "the lychgate" is gate between holt_green and churchyard.

  Thing ferry "Wren's ferry" on ferry_crossing {
    State tied blocking "Wren's ferry is tied up at the quay steps. Nobody else will take it out while its keeper waits for news.".
    State running "Wren's ferry rides at the quay steps, ready to cross.".
  }
  Event ferry_free near ferry when state(ferry, tied) and at(missing, home) "Wren comes down to the steps and slaps the ferry's gunwale. 'Anywhere you need on this river, and no charge. Not while I keep the ferry.'" then {
    Assert state(ferry, running).
  }

  Person bears "the bears of the holt" at den_clearing {
    Role "a sow bear and her grown cub". Species bear. Numbers 2. Called "the sow", "the cub".
    State denning blocking "A sow bear and her grown cub have denned in the bracken across the holt way. The sow rises on her hind legs and blows at you.".
    State gone "Trampled bracken and the smell of old smoke where the bears denned. The holt way is clear.".
    Guards holt_mid. Guards holt_east.
    Change smoke "Lay green wood upwind and smoke {self} out of the bracken" from denning to gone needing woodcraft.
  }
  Rule bears_leave when state(bears, gone) and at(bears, den_clearing) { Retract at(bears, den_clearing). }

  Person osric "Osric" at holly_room {
    Role "landlord of the Holly Bush". Profession innkeeper. Peaceable.
    Sells rations for 2 coin from 6.
    Sells torch for 1 coin from 4.
  }
  Person agnes "Agnes" at holt_green {
    Role "sexton of Brackenholt". Ancestry human. Peaceable.
  }
  Person cutter "Wat" at holly_room {
    Role "woodcutter". Ancestry human. Peaceable.
  }
  Topic osric_crossing with osric "Ask Osric about Brackenholt" when true {
    Says "'Woodcutters, charcoal and the ferry, that's Brackenholt,' says Osric. 'We buried our dead in the compact refuge under Censer Hill once, the same as Reedwake and Chalkcross. Now we bury them in the churchyard here, and lately we don't sleep so well.' He looks up the lane toward the tower and says no more.".
  }

  Observe landing_scene at landing when true "A timber stage on the east bank, slick with river water. Reedwake's roofs show across the Serewater.".
  Observe holt_day at holt_green when not dark() "Charcoal smoke hangs over a green ringed by woodcutters' cottages and a squat churchyard wall. Above the village a grey watchtower stands among the oaks.".
  Observe holt_night at holt_green when dark() "Brackenholt is barred and shuttered. Up the lane, high in the old tower, a light burns.".
  Observe holly_scene at holly_room when true "Oak beams black with smoke, a fire of offcuts, and axes hung by their heads along one wall.".
  Observe edge_scene at holt_edge when true "Bracken shoulder-high under old oaks. The holt way dips toward the river; a clawed oak shows where something big has scratched.".
  Observe clearing_scene at den_clearing when true "A clearing of flattened bracken, bones, and a strong animal smell.".
  Observe tower_foot_scene at tower_foot when true "The lane ends in nettles under Holt tower. Oaks crowd the walls.".
  Observe churchyard_scene at churchyard when true "Old yews lean over stones that lean every way. The oldest graves, under the biggest yew, are cut deeper than the rest.".
  Goal false.
}

Module serewater_march "The Serewater March" {
  Description "Reedwake, a wool-and-barge town on the flooding Serewater; the willow floodplain between it and the hills; and the chalk downs above, where the sheep of Chalkcross graze.".

  Person maud "Maud" at taproom {

    Sells rations for 2 coin from 4.
  }
  Person nera "Nera" at shop_floor {
    Role "outfitter". Profession herbalist. Peaceable.
    Sells rations for 2 coin from 6.
    Sells bandages for 1 coin from 3.
    Sells rope for 1 coin from 2.

    Sells antidote for 3 coin from 2.
    Sells healingdraught for 3 coin from 1.
  }

    Sells rations for 2 coin from 4.
    Sells torch for 1 coin from 3.
  }
  Person tam "Tam" at cross_green {
    Role "drover". Ancestry human. Peaceable.
  }
  Topic hedda_downs with hedda "Ask Hedda about the downs" when true {
    Says "'Sheep, chalk and wind,' says Hedda. 'And Garth's flock on the ridge, what's left of it. Reedwake's an hour and a half down; Brackenholt's across the river, or two hours the holt way if you don't mind bears. Nobody minds bears until they meet one.'".
  }
  Topic tam_road with tam "Ask Tam about the holt way" when true {
    Says "'I take the flock round by Reedwake now,' says Tam. 'There's a sow bear and her grown cub in the bracken on the holt way, and they don't move for anybody. Smoke shifts a bear if you know how to lay it. I don't.'".
  }
  Topic nera_preparation with nera "Ask Nera how to prepare" when true {
    Says "'Plan your way back before you go down,' says Nera. 'Maud's beds are three coin, supper with it. I sell what I have, and when it is gone it is gone. Antidote treats poison, not a crushed skull. Take a line; there are clefts in that hill that strength alone won't get you across.'".
  }
  Topic nera_interest with nera "Ask why the town cares about Censer Hill" when true {
    Says "'Bronze buys work; washed-out bones buy grief. The foundry served three settlements once, and the refuge under it sheltered all of them in the great flood. Some of them are still down there. Ask at the shrine before you treat everything under that hill as salvage.'".
  }

  Observe quay_night at quay when dark() "The quay is dark and empty. Water slaps the piles, the barges ride at their ropes, and a lamp still burns in the Oar's window.".

The Oar's sign creaks over one door, Nera's herbs hang in another, the shrine porch faces the water, and a salvage company's chalked board leans by the office.".
  Observe taproom_scene at taproom when true "Dry boots steam above the hearth. Bargemen eat at the long table, and stairs climb to the pallets above.".
  Observe shop_scene at shop_floor when true "Bunches of herbs hang from the beams over shelves of jars, coils of rope, stoppered antidotes and wrapped rations.".
  Observe shrine_scene at shrine when true "Two small altars face each other under a low roof. Water-stained name slips are pinned to every beam.".
  Observe ferry_scene at ferry_room when true "A low kitchen with the tide board nailed by the door and a kettle on the hob.".
  Observe office_scene at salvage_office when true "A ledger lies open on a trestle beside a sketch of foundry machinery. A licence is pinned above it, its seal still bright.".
  Observe causeway_scene at causeway when true "Old stones run out across the floodplain between willow poles. Waterfowl lift from the sedges. A track climbs the chalk ridge; a lower path drops into the reeds.".
  Observe ridge_scene at ridge when true "Short grass and hawthorn on pale chalk. Sheep bells sound along the drove road from Chalkcross. Reedwake lies far below.".
  Observe cross_day at cross_green when not dark() "A dozen flint cottages round a green cropped short by sheep. A stone cross leans at the crossing of the drove roads, and smoke curls from the Fold.".
  Observe cross_night at cross_green when dark() "Chalkcross is shut up for the night. A lantern hangs over the Fold's door, and the wind hums in the cross.".
  Observe fold_scene at fold_room when true "A low room smelling of wet wool and peat smoke. Shepherds' crooks lean by the door; a board by the hearth is chalked with sheep counts.".
  Goal false.
}

  Passage cairn_road "the road past the cairn" is road between switchbacks and cairn taking 1 hour.

  Company party "Your company" of 3 at market.
  Initially Set quantity(party, gold) to 15. Initially Set quantity(party, rations) to 2.

  // The weather turns before dawn: rain in the valley is snow on the high ground. Rain swells the ford; snow shuts
  // the goat path and slows the Gap road; fog hides the road's landmarks and those who wait beside it.
  Entity sky: scenery "the sky over the Varrow".
  Entity fair: condition "fair". Entity rain: condition "rain". Entity fog: condition "fog".
  Initially Assert state(sky, fair).
  Rule rain_comes when untilLight(clock) == 1 and state(sky, fair) and dice(clock) <= 25 { Assert state(sky, rain). }
  Rule fog_comes when untilLight(clock) == 1 and state(sky, fair) and dice(clock) > 25 and dice(clock) <= 40 { Assert state(sky, fog). }
  Rule clears when untilLight(clock) == 1 and not state(sky, fair) and dice(clock) > 55 { Assert state(sky, fair). }
  Thing spate "the Varrow at the ford" on the_ford is scenery {
    State fordable "The Varrow runs knee-deep and clear over the ford stones.".
    State swollen blocking "The Varrow is in spate, brown and loud, over the ford stones. Nobody crosses today.".
  }
  Rule ford_swells when state(sky, rain) and state(spate, fordable) { Assert state(spate, swollen). }
  Rule ford_falls when state(sky, fair) and state(spate, swollen) and untilLight(clock) == 2 { Assert state(spate, fordable). }
  Thing drifts "the snow on the shoulder" on goat_path is scenery {
    State clear "The goat path picks its way up the shoulder of the fell, steep but clear.".
    State drifted blocking "Snow has filled the goat path to the waist. Nobody goes over the shoulder until it melts.".
  }
  Rule snow_falls when state(sky, rain) and state(drifts, clear) { Assert state(drifts, drifted). }
  Rule snow_melts when state(sky, fair) and state(drifts, drifted) and untilLight(clock) == 3 { Assert state(drifts, clear). }
  Rule gap_slow when state(sky, rain) { Set travelTime(gap_road) to 18. Set travelTime(cairn_road) to 9. }
  Rule gap_fast when not state(sky, rain) { Set travelTime(gap_road) to 12. Set travelTime(cairn_road) to 6. }
  Observe rain_low at barrows when state(sky, rain) "Rain sweeps up the valley in grey curtains. The road is mud.".
  Observe rain_ford at ford_green when state(sky, rain) "Rain drums on the Heron's thatch.".
  Observe rain_high at switchbacks when state(sky, rain) "Sleet on the switchbacks, and snow higher up: the shoulder of the fell has gone white.".
  Observe fog_low at barrows when state(sky, fog) "Fog lies in the valley so thick the barrows are only shapes, and the road vanishes ten paces on.".
  Observe fog_high at cairn when state(sky, fog) "The cairn looms out of fog. Below, nothing; above, nothing.".

  // Hollin.
  Observe market_scene at market when true "Hollin market: carts, a wool-cross, a well with a stone roof. Wagons for the Gap stand loaded and going nowhere; their drivers argue about the Toll.".
  Observe wheatsheaf_scene at wheatsheaf when true "A long low taproom smelling of beer and wet wool. A board by the hearth lists the Toll in chalk, and someone has added a rude drawing.".
  Observe chandlery_scene at chandlery when true "Coils of rope, poles in a rack, lamp-oil in stone jars and sacks of hard bread.".
  Observe goldsmith_scene at goldsmith when true "A narrow counting-room with a barred window, a balance under a glass bell, and a stone for testing gold.".
  Observe temple_scene at lamp_temple when true "A small temple with no images, only lamps: hundreds of them, in niches, on chains, in a great iron wheel, all kept burning.".
  Observe reeve_scene at reeve_hall when true "The reeve's hall is a counting-house with a dais. Ledgers lie open; most of the figures are red.".
  Person wenna "Wenna" at wheatsheaf {
    Role "keeper of the Wheatsheaf". Profession innkeeper. Peaceable.
    Sells rations for 2 coin from 8.
  }
  Person ottar "Ottar" at chandlery {
    Role "chandler". Profession herbalist. Peaceable.

Module care "Rest, mending and lessons" {
  Kind member. Kind ability. Kind reward. Kind circle.
  Entity circle_1: circle "first-level slot". Entity circle_2: circle "second-level slot".
  Entity circle_3: circle "third-level slot". Entity circle_4: circle "fourth-level slot".
  Entity circle_5: circle "fifth-level slot".
  Relation swappable(member, circle, ability, ability).
  Kind quality.
  Entity strength: quality "Strength". Entity dexterity: quality "Dexterity". Entity constitution: quality "Constitution".
  Entity intelligence: quality "Intelligence". Entity wisdom: quality "Wisdom". Entity charisma: quality "Charisma".
  Relation improvable(member). Relation learnable(member, ability).
  Relation memberOf(member, group).
  Relation fieldUsable(ability).
  Relation awake(member). Relation needsCare(member). Relation canCast(member, ability). Relation treatable(member, ability).
  Relation restful(place). Relation offeredAt(reward, place). Relation giftEffect(reward, ability).
  Relation rewardFor(reward, fact). Relation claimed(reward).
  Goal false.
  Action field_spell(actor: group, caster: member, technique: ability, recipient: member, site: place) "Have {caster} use {technique} on {recipient}" {
    Description "Use a known healing, cleansing or persistent ward ability outside combat. Its normal mana cost is paid; combat cooldowns do not apply.".
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and memberOf(caster, actor) and memberOf(recipient, actor)
      and fieldUsable(technique) and awake(caster) and awake(recipient) and canCast(caster, technique) and treatable(recipient, technique).
    Resolve invoke(technique, caster, recipient).
    Result "{caster} tends {recipient} with {technique}.".
  }
  Action prepare_spell(actor: group, caster: member, tier: circle, outgoing: ability, incoming: ability) "Have {caster} prepare {incoming} in place of {outgoing}" {
    Description "An hour of study or prayer. A spell prepared in a slot still ready can be cast at once; in a slot already spent, after the next rest.".
    Requires able(actor) and memberOf(caster, actor) and awake(caster) and swappable(caster, tier, outgoing, incoming).
    Time 6.
    Resolve prepare(caster, tier, outgoing, incoming).
    Result "{caster} spends an hour over {incoming}.".
  }
  Action raise_quality(actor: group, member: member, quality: quality) "Have {member} raise {quality}" {
    Description "Each level gained lets a companion raise one quality by a point. Strength lands blows and Dexterity turns them; Constitution adds hit points at the next level; Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma feeds a caster's spells.".
    Requires able(actor) and memberOf(member, actor) and awake(member) and improvable(member).
    Resolve improve(member, quality).
    Result "{member} grows in {quality}.".
  }
  Action learn_spell(actor: group, member: member, spell: ability) "Have {member} learn {spell}" {
    Description "Each level gained lets a caster add a spell of their tradition, of a level they can cast, to what they know. It can be prepared from then on.".
    Requires able(actor) and memberOf(member, actor) and awake(member) and learnable(member, spell).
    Resolve learn(member, spell).
    Result "{member} learns {spell}.".
  }
  Action rest(actor: group, site: place) "Rest and recover at {site}" {
    Description "Spend six hours and one shared ration at a safe shelter. Living companions recover HP and mana; bleeding is treated. Poison and death remain. Other people and deadlines continue.".
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and restful(site) and quantity(actor, rations) >= 1.
    Time 36. Resolve recover(actor). Interrupted when threatened(actor).
    On success { Decrease quantity(actor, rations) by 1. }
    Result "You eat, bind your hurts and sleep for six hours.".
  }
  Action learn_reward(actor: group, gift: reward, recipient: member, lesson: ability, proof: fact, site: place) "Accept {gift} for {recipient}" {

      and awake(recipient) and giftEffect(gift, lesson) and rewardFor(gift, proof) and knows(actor, proof)
      and not claimed(gift).
    Resolve reward(lesson, recipient).
    On success { Assert claimed(gift). Retract offeredAt(gift, site). Retract at(gift, site). }
    Result "{recipient} studies {gift} until {lesson} comes easily.".
  }
}

Module world_passages "Passages, obstacles and the condition of things" {
  Kind passage. Kind condition. Kind change. Kind thing. Kind waykind. Kind hazard.
  // What is seen and changes but is not handled: the weather, a river, a beacon on a far hill.
  Kind scenery.
  Relation passageKind(passage, waykind). Measure travelTime(passage).
  Relation connects(passage, place, place).
  Relation on(entity, passage).
  Relation guards(group, passage).
  Relation state(entity, condition) exclusive.
  Relation blocksWhen(entity, condition). Relation harmsWhen(entity, condition).
  Relation hurtsWith(entity, hazard). Relation hurtsInto(entity, condition).
  Relation revealedBy(entity, fact).
  // Containment: a thing or item inside another, reachable while that one is not shut; a receptacle can take more.
  Relation inside(entity, entity). Relation receptacle(entity). Relation closesWhen(entity, condition).
  // A hazard that strikes a company: the world turns it on one of its members (a trap sprung, a stone that falls).
  Relation strikes(hazard, group).
  // What can be tried on a thing (looked over closely, prodded, pried at...), and what has been.
  Kind verb. Relation probeable(entity). Relation tried(entity, verb).
  Relation needs(entity, entity).
  Relation changeOf(change, entity). Relation changeFrom(change, condition). Relation changeTo(change, condition).
  Relation changeKnows(change, fact). Relation consumes(change, good). Relation spends(change, itemkind).
  Relation hobbled(group).
  Relation following(group, group).
  Query holding(a: group, k: itemkind) means memberOf(?m, a) and ownedItem(?i, ?m) and itemKind(?i, k).
  Query meets(a: group, n: entity) means capable(a, n) or holding(a, n) or (following(a, ?l) and holding(?l, n)).
  Query equippedFor(a: group, x: entity) means not needs(x, ?n) or (needs(x, ?n) and meets(a, ?n)).
  Query informedFor(a: group, c: change) means not changeKnows(c, ?f) or (changeKnows(c, ?f) and knows(a, ?f)).
  Query visibleTo(w: passage, a: group) means not revealedBy(w, ?f) or (revealedBy(w, ?f) and knows(a, ?f))
    or (revealedBy(w, ?g) and following(a, ?l) and knows(?l, ?g)).
  Query barred(w: passage) means on(?o, w) and state(?o, ?s) and blocksWhen(?o, ?s).
  // Who holds the key to what bars a way, and those who serve them, go through it as if it were open.
  Relation keyholder(group, entity).
  Query opens(a: group, o: entity) means keyholder(a, o) or (serves(a, ?m) and keyholder(?m, o)).
  Query barredFor(w: passage, a: group) means on(?o, w) and state(?o, ?s) and blocksWhen(?o, ?s) and not opens(a, ?o).
  Query watched(w: passage) means guards(?g, w) and able(?g) and state(?g, ?t) and blocksWhen(?g, ?t)
    and at(?g, ?p) and connects(w, ?p, ?q).
  Query obstructed(w: passage) means barred(w) or watched(w).
  Query watchedAgainst(w: passage, a: group) means guards(?g, w) and able(?g) and state(?g, ?t) and blocksWhen(?g, ?t)
    and at(?g, ?p) and connects(w, ?p, ?q) and not allied(?g, a) and not tolerates(?g, a).
  Query hazardous(w: passage) means on(?h, w) and state(?h, ?s) and harmsWhen(?h, ?s).
  Query mobile(a: group) means not hobbled(a) or following(a, ?l).
  Query together(a: group, b: group) means at(a, ?p) and at(b, ?p).
  Query shut(c: entity) means state(c, ?s) and closesWhen(c, ?s).
  // A thing hidden until something is known is not there, for a company that does not know it; nor is a thing on a way
  // the company does not know of.
  Query onHiddenWay(x: entity, a: group) means on(x, ?w) and not visibleTo(?w, a).
  Query noticed(x: entity, a: group) means (not revealedBy(x, ?f) or (revealedBy(x, ?f) and knows(a, ?f)))
    and not onHiddenWay(x, a).
  Query reaches(a: group, t: entity) means noticed(t, a) and ((at(a, ?p) and at(t, ?p))
    or (at(a, ?q) and on(t, ?w) and connects(?w, ?q, ?r))
    or (at(a, ?q) and guards(t, ?w) and connects(?w, ?q, ?r) and at(t, ?r))
    or (at(a, ?h) and inside(t, ?c) and at(?c, ?h) and not shut(?c))).
  Query passable(w: passage, a: group) means visibleTo(w, a) and not barredFor(w, a) and not watchedAgainst(w, a)
    and not hazardous(w)
    and equippedFor(a, w).
  Goal false.

  Action go(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place) "Take {way} to {destination}" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and passable(way, actor)
      and mobile(actor).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert at(actor, destination). }
    Seen "{actor} takes {way} toward {destination}.".
  }
  Action slip_past(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place, gatekeeper: group) "Slip past {gatekeeper} by {way}" {
    Description "Someone who moves quietly takes the company past a watcher without a fight or a bargain. The watcher stays where it is, and will be there on the way back.".
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and guards(gatekeeper, way)
      and able(gatekeeper) and state(gatekeeper, ?t) and blocksWhen(gatekeeper, ?t) and not tolerates(gatekeeper, actor)
      and capable(actor, stealth)
      and visibleTo(way, actor) and not barred(way) and not hazardous(way) and equippedFor(actor, way) and mobile(actor).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert at(actor, destination). }
    Result "One at a time, keeping low and downwind, you slip past {gatekeeper}.".
  }
  Action risk(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place, trap: entity, blow: hazard, after: condition, victim: member) "Risk {trap}; {victim} goes first" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and on(trap, way)
      and state(trap, ?s) and harmsWhen(trap, ?s) and hurtsWith(trap, blow) and hurtsInto(trap, after)
      and memberOf(victim, actor) and awake(victim) and visibleTo(way, actor) and not obstructed(way)
      and equippedFor(actor, way) and mobile(actor).
    Resolve expose(blow, victim).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert state(trap, after). Assert at(actor, destination). }
    On failure { Assert state(trap, after). }
  }
  Action change_thing(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition) "{how}" {
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and not consumes(how, ?g) and not spends(how, ?k).
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). }
  }
  Action change_thing_spending(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition, spent: item, form: itemkind, carrier: member) "{how}, using {carrier}'s {spent}" {
    Description "What it takes is used up doing it.".
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and spends(how, form) and memberOf(carrier, actor) and awake(carrier)
      and ownedItem(spent, carrier) and itemKind(spent, form).
    Resolve drop(spent, carrier).
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). }
  }
  Action change_thing_paying(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition, spent: good) "{how}" {
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and consumes(how, spent) and quantity(actor, spent) >= 1.
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). Decrease quantity(actor, spent) by 1. }
  }
}

  Passage kitchen_door "the kitchen doorway" is doorway between hall and kitchen.
  Passage name_way "the passage to the name room" between kitchen and name_room.
  Passage sluice_arch "the sluice arch" is arch between hall and sluice.
  Passage limestone_stair "the limestone stair" is stair between sluice and lower taking 10 minutes.
  Passage hidden_stair "the concealed stair" is stair between name_room and crypt hidden until stair_known.
  Passage crypt_steps "the crypt steps" is steps between lower and crypt.
  Passage court_arch "the court arch" is arch between crypt and court.
  Passage vault_gate "the vault gate" is gate between court and vault.
  Passage shutter_way "the shutter passage" between court and founders.
  Passage cleft "the cleft" is climb between crypt and founders needing climbing.
  Passage chalk_passage "the chalk passage" between founders and chalk.
  Passage chalk_fault "the chalk fault" is crawl between chalk and drain_mouth taking 30 minutes hidden until chalk_exit.

  Person boar "a reedbank boar" at causeway {
    Role "a boar rooting in the reeds". Species boar. Level 1.
    State rooting blocking "A boar has rooted up the low path and stands across it, bristling, watching you.".
    State wary "The boar has drawn off into the sedge. The low path is clear.".
    Guards low_path.
    Change pass "Read {self}'s warning posture and give it room" from rooting to wary needing woodcraft.
    Change bait "Scatter a ration for {self} away from the path" from rooting to wary consuming rations.
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(boar) to 10.

  Person hound "Ash" at gallery {
    Role "a cave hound". Species cave_hound. Level 2.
    State guarding blocking "A lean cave hound stands across the hoist passage, head low, lips back from its teeth.".
    State calm "The cave hound lies in the mould dust, watching, no longer barring the hoist passage.".
    Guards hoist_passage.
    Change soothe "Approach {self} slowly, low and quiet" from guarding to calm needing woodcraft.
    Change feed "Toss {self} a ration" from guarding to calm consuming rations.
  }
  Event growl near hound when state(hound, guarding) and together(party, hound) "The hound's growl fills the gallery. It does not come at you; it holds the hoist passage.".
  Initially Set encounterXp(hound) to 20.
  Person hesta "Hesta" at gallery {
    Role "the foundry's herb gatherer". Profession herbalist. Peaceable.
    Offers healing "clean water, salve and linen" for 2 coin.
    Sells rations for 2 coin from 2.
  }
  Topic hesta_help with hesta "Ask Hesta about Ash and the hill" when not refusesService(hesta, actor) {
    Says "'Ash kept me company after the foundry closed. Give him space, a little food, or that quiet hunter's look. I'll dress your wounds if you need it. But don't strike him in front of me and then ask me to patch you up. The ward blade is still in the valve chamber; fire runs along it, but no steel will turn a steam jet. And the dry stair from the stores goes down to the old refuge without trusting the hoist.'".
  }
  Event hesta_refuses near hesta when witnessedAttack(hesta, party, hound) "Hesta draws the linen basket to her chest. 'I saw you strike Ash. Find your salve elsewhere.'" then { Assert refusesService(hesta, party). }
  Topic hesta_after with hesta "Speak to Hesta after the fight" when refusesService(hesta, actor) {
    Says "'Nera keeps a shop in town. I will not stop you leaving, but I won't serve you.'".
  }

  Item ward_focus "the warder's copper focus" is warding_focus at workshop.
  Item line_cache "a surveyor's harness and pitons" is climbing_harness at stores.
  Item names_lantern "the lantern of names" is lantern_of_names at name_room.
  Item register_copy "the waxed refuge register" is burial_register at name_room.

  Person sentinel "the bronze boiler sentinel" at boiler {
    Role "an abandoned inspection construct". Species bronze_construct. Level 1.
  }
  Observe sentinel_warning at boiler when able(sentinel) "A squat bronze inspector turns on stiff joints. Its plated body resists steel and cannot be poisoned. The arch and pipe walk remain open; nothing compels you to fight it.".
  Item ward_sword "the foundry's Longsword of Flames" is longsword_of_flames at boiler.
  Hazard foundry_steam "Scalding foundry steam" means "Deal (1d6) fire damage to ally unless dexterity save against (11).".
  Thing steam_pipe "the split steam pipe" on boiler_arch {
    State leaking dangerous "A split pipe hisses over the boiler arch. Fresh scorch marks stripe the boiler arch; turning its seized valve needs a crowbar. A fire ward can blunt a scald, but the jet must still be crossed.".
    State shut "The pipe's valve is turned hard shut. The boiler arch is clear.".
    State vented "The old pipe has vented its last pressure. Wet stone steams underfoot.".
    Change close "Turn the steam valve with a bar" from leaking to shut needing crowbar.
    Hurts with foundry_steam when leaking then vented.
  }
  Thing padlock "the stores padlock" on stores_door {
    State locked blocking "A rusted padlock holds the stores door shut.".
    State open "The stores door stands open; its padlock hangs from the hasp.".
    Change pick "Pick the stores padlock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change wrench "Wrench the padlock's hasp out of the rotten door" from locked to open needing brawn.
  }

  Hazard counterweight_drop "The hoist counterweight" means "Deal (2d6) physical damage to ally unless dexterity save against (12).".
  Thing counterweight "the hoist counterweight" on hoist_shaft {
    State armed dangerous "An uncovered counterweight hangs over the shaft. It releases when the cable takes weight.".
    State pinned "A wedge holds the counterweight's release. The shaft is safe to climb.".
    State braced "A line is lashed around the counterweight. It will not fall.".
    State sprung "The counterweight lies at the bottom of the shaft, its cable slack.".
    Change pin "Pin the counterweight's release" from armed to pinned needing trapwork after learning hoist_warning.
    Change brace "Lash {self} with a line" from armed to braced needing rope after learning hoist_warning.
    Hurts with counterweight_drop when armed then sprung.
  }
  Hazard kitchen_vapour "Sealed kitchen vapour" means "Deal (1d4) poison damage to ally unless constitution save against (11). Apply poisoned to ally for 3 turns unless constitution save against (11).".
  Thing crock "the split preservative crock" on name_way {
    State venting dangerous "A split preservative crock sits under a tilting floorboard. Greenish dust traces the floor.".
    State pinned "The floorboard under the crock is nailed down. Nothing will vent.".
    State emptied "The crock has vented. The air is stale, but clear.".
    Change pin "Pin the tilting floorboard" from venting to pinned needing trapwork after learning vapour_warning.
    Hurts with kitchen_vapour when venting then emptied.
  }
  Hazard shutter_blow "The bronze burial shutters" means "Deal (1d8) physical damage to ally unless dexterity save against (13).".
  Thing shutters "the bronze burial shutters" on shutter_way {
    State armed dangerous "Articulated bronze shutters hang over the passage to the founders' gallery, poised to strike.".
    State pinned "The shutters' release is pinned. They hang still.".
    State sprung "The shutters have struck and jammed half-open.".
    Change pin "Pin the shutter release" from armed to pinned needing trapwork after learning shutter_warning.
    Change brace "Brace the shutters with a line" from armed to pinned needing rope after learning shutter_warning.
    Hurts with shutter_blow when armed then sprung.
  }

  Person custodian "the Mortuary Custodian" at court {
    Role "the keepers' funerary guardian". Species bronze_construct. Level 5.
    State guarding blocking "The Custodian stands across the vault gate, bronze fingers folded.".
    State admitting "The Custodian has stepped aside from the vault gate. It still watches.".
    Guards vault_gate.
    Change admit "Show {self} the keepers' custody writ" from guarding to admitting after learning custody_writ.
  }
  Initially Set encounterXp(custodian) to 120.
  Topic custodian_demand with custodian "Address the Mortuary Custodian" when able(custodian) {
    Says "Bronze fingers fold. 'CUSTODY IS NOT CONQUEST. NAME THE DEAD. BEAR THE KEEPER'S WRIT. OR RETURN BY THE WAY YOU CAME.' The same words are cut into its breastplate.".
  }

  Discovery crawl_known "A tram crawl runs from the dry stores to the back of the hoist room; it is marked on a surveyor's board." {
    Source survey_board "a scratched survey board" at vestibule readable by party.
  }
  Discovery hoist_warning "The hoist counterweight releases when the cable takes weight. A trapwork hand can pin it; a line can lash it. Otherwise whoever goes first takes the risk." {
    Source scored_timber "a scored warning on the hoist timber" at hoist readable by party.
  }
  Discovery vapour_warning "The split crock vents poison when its floorboard tilts. A trapwork hand can pin the board. An antidote treats the poison afterwards." {
    Source crock_label "a preservative crock's warning label" at kitchen readable by party.
  }
  Discovery shutter_warning "The bronze shutter strikes an unready intruder. Its release can be pinned or braced with a line. The court itself is safe to stand in." {
    Source shutter_scratches "old scratches by the shutter release" at court readable by party.
  }
  Discovery chalk_exit "A chalk fault runs from the founders' gallery up to the drain mouth. Once learned, it is a way home." {
    Source survey_scratches "a chalk survey scratched on the wall" at chalk readable by party.
  }
  Entity register_pages: source "the register's waxed pages".
  Initially Assert at(register_pages, name_room). Initially Assert intact(register_pages). Initially Assert noticeable(register_pages).
  Initially Assert reveals(register_pages, register_survives). Initially Assert mayExamine(party, register_pages).
  Entity stair_known: fact "A concealed stair joins the name room and the family crypt".
  Entity lantern_letters: source "names written in funeral light".
  Initially Assert established(stair_known). Initially Assert at(lantern_letters, name_room). Initially Assert intact(lantern_letters).
  Initially Assert reveals(lantern_letters, stair_known). Initially Assert mayExamine(party, lantern_letters).
  Rule lit_letters when at(party, name_room) and capable(party, reading_the_dead) { Assert noticeable(lantern_letters). }
  Action puzzle_script(actor: group) "Puzzle out the compact's old script on the rear wall" {
    Description "Someone who reads old hands can make out what the faint lettering says, without the lantern's light.".
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, name_room) and at(lantern_letters, name_room) and capable(actor, lore)
      and not knows(actor, stair_known).
    Time 2.
    On success { Assert knows(actor, stair_known). }
    Result "Letter by letter, in the old compact hand: the names of the sheltered dead, and among them a line that is not a name. It says the stair behind the shelves goes down to the family crypt.".
  }
  Rule dark_letters when not capable(party, reading_the_dead) { Retract noticeable(lantern_letters). }

  Observe yard_scene at yard when true "Rusting tram rails cross an ash-grown yard. A roofless arch opens into the upper works. A surveyor's scratches mark a climb up the hoist side; without a proper harness it is too exposed.".
  Observe drain_scene at drain_mouth when true "A broken culvert breathes cold air out of the hillside. Water already runs ankle-deep along its floor.".
  Observe vestibule_scene at vestibule when true "Lime-washed walls, a fallen lamp bracket, and footprints in the dust heading deeper in.".
  Observe workshop_scene at workshop when true "Half-cast bells lean against the walls. Chalk circles mark reusable bronze; older burial marks below the stores door declare another custody. Doorways lead to the stores and the vestibule; steps go down to the casting gallery, and the culvert mouth gapes in the floor.".
  Observe stores_scene at stores when true "Collapsed shelving and oilcloth bundles. A soot-black dry stair goes down to the refuge. The far wall is old brick with a low, black opening at its foot.".
  Observe boiler_scene at boiler when true "A wheel valve and a row of cold boilers fill the room. The workshop arch leads back; a narrow pipe walk reaches the casting gallery.".
  Observe gallery_scene at gallery when true "Ceramic moulds stand in rows beneath a broken roof. The far end narrows into the hoist passage.".
  Observe hoist_scene at hoist when true "A slack cable hangs from the hoist drum. Timber and tools lie where a rack came down. The shaft drops to the refuge.".
  Observe hall_scene at hall when true "Three settlements carved their household tallies on the refuge pillars. This was a shelter before it was an ossuary. The dry stair, the hoist landing, the kitchens and the sluice walk all meet here.".
  Observe landing_scene at landing when true "The hoist cage has sunk into gravel. A narrow crawl joins the flood hall.".
  Observe kitchen_scene at kitchen when true "Cold hearths and broken crocks. A passage leads on to the name room.".
  Observe name_room_scene at name_room when true "Waxed shelves and a funeral lampstand occupy the dry wall.".
  Observe faint_letters at name_room when not capable(party, reading_the_dead) "Tiny lettering shines faintly on the rear wall, too faint to read by ordinary light.".
  Observe lit_letters_scene at name_room when capable(party, reading_the_dead) "In the lantern's consecrated light, names written on the rear wall stand out clearly, and an arrow among them points behind the shelves.".
  Observe sluice_scene at sluice when true "Stone gutters run through the refuge. Flood marks record the river's rises. A limestone stair goes down.".
  Observe lower_scene at lower when true "River-smoothed limestone steps turn toward the family crypt. Cold incense hangs in the air.".
  Observe crypt_scene at crypt when true "Small alcoves hold bundled remains under numbered tiles. The court arch stands ahead. A cleft drops toward the founders' gallery; it needs a harness.".
  Observe court_scene at court when true "A bronze dais rises beneath articulated burial shutters. The vault gate lies beyond the dais; a shuttered passage leads aside to the founders' gallery.".
  Observe vault_scene at vault when true "Named stone drawers stand in order, each cut with a family number.".
  Observe founders_scene at founders when true "Three bronze founders hold tools rather than crowns. Their plinths name the flood compact of Reedwake, Chalkcross and Brackenholt. A chalk passage leads upward.".
  Observe chalk_scene at chalk when true "A pale fault runs upward through the chalk. Your old footprints are undisturbed in the dust.".
  Observe guardian_dead at court when dead(custodian) "The Custodian lies still. Its burial chain hangs severed from a bronze hand. The vault is open, and the keepers have no guardian here now.".
  Goal false.
}
data/sites/lanthorn/site.kyr:
Module lanthorn "The Lanthorn" {
  Description "A citadel of the Lamplighters across the head of the Gap: a gatehouse over the road, a court and a beacon tower on the crag above it, and below, cut into the rock, the cellars where they kept bottled light. Ottilie Ninefingers holds the gate and the court and tolls the road. Nobody holds the cellars.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place varrow "The region" is region.
  Place toll_gate "The road below the gate" is room.
  Place gap_far "The road beyond the gate" is room.
  Place shoulder "The fell above" is room.
  Place home_town "The town beyond" is room.
  Place supplier "Where the crew buy on credit" is room.
  Place lamps "The temple of lamps" is room.
  Entity reeve: group "The reeve who wants the Toll ended".
  Entity bounty: fact "The reeve's bounty on the Toll".

  Place lanthorn "the Lanthorn" is site within varrow at 3, 0.
  Place gatehouse "The gatehouse" is level within lanthorn.
  Place citadel "The court" is level within lanthorn.
  Place tower "The beacon tower" is level within lanthorn.
  Place roof "The top of the tower" is level within lanthorn.
  Place wick "The Wick" is level within lanthorn.
  Place undercroft "The undercroft" is level within lanthorn.

  Place guardroom "the guardroom" is room within gatehouse at 0, 0.
  Place winch_room "the winch room" is room within citadel at 0, 2.
  Place gate_passage "the gate passage" is room within gatehouse at 0, 1.
  Place wall_walk "the wall walk" is room within citadel at 1, 2.
  Place gorge "the gorge under the walls" is room within gatehouse at 0, 2.
  Place kitchen "the kitchen" is room within citadel at 0, 0.
  Place court "the Lamp Court" is room within citadel at 1, 0.
  Place chapter_house "the chapter house" is room within citadel at 2, 0.
  Place tower_foot "the foot of the beacon tower" is room within citadel at 1, 1.
  Place solar "the warden's solar" is room within tower at 0, 0.
  Place lantern "the lantern" is room within roof at 0, 0.
  Place stair_foot "the Wick crossing" is room within wick at 1, 0.
  Place cistern "the cistern" is room within wick at 0, 0.
  Place lamp_works "the lamp-works" is room within wick at 2, 0.
  Place glasshouse "the glass-house" is room within wick at 3, 0.
  Place bottle_cellar "the bottle cellar" is room within wick at 2, 1.
  Place deep_cellar "the deep cellar" is room within undercroft at 0, 0.
  Place first_vault "the vault of the First Light" is room within undercroft at 1, 0.
  Place crack_foot "the bottom of the crack" is room within undercroft at 0, 1.
  Initially Assert unlit(stair_foot). Initially Assert unlit(cistern). Initially Assert unlit(lamp_works).
  Initially Assert unlit(glasshouse). Initially Assert unlit(bottle_cellar). Initially Assert unlit(deep_cellar).
  Initially Assert unlit(first_vault). Initially Assert unlit(crack_foot). Initially Assert unlit(gorge).
  Initially Assert indoors(guardroom). Initially Assert indoors(winch_room). Initially Assert indoors(kitchen).
  Initially Assert indoors(chapter_house). Initially Assert indoors(solar).

  // The road goes through the gatehouse; the citadel is on the crag above it, the cellars in the rock below.
  Passage outer_gate "the outer gate" is gate between toll_gate and gate_passage.
  Passage far_gate "the far portcullis" is gate between gate_passage and gap_far.
  Passage guard_door "the guardroom door" is door between gate_passage and guardroom.
  Passage guard_stair "the guardroom stair" is stair between guardroom and winch_room.
  Passage winch_door "the winch-room door" is door between winch_room and wall_walk.
  Passage court_steps "the court steps" is steps between wall_walk and court.
  Passage kitchen_door "the kitchen door" is door between court and kitchen.
  Passage chapter_doors "the chapter-house doors" is doorway between court and chapter_house.
  Passage tower_door "the tower door" is door between court and tower_foot.
  Passage tower_stair "the tower stair" is stair between tower_foot and solar.
  Passage lantern_stair "the lantern stair" is stair between solar and lantern.
  // Other ways in: the kitchen postern, barred inside; a chain from the fell to the top of the tower; the cistern's
  // overflow from the gorge; and, from the cellars, a stair, a well, a flue and a crack that goes further down.
  Passage postern "the kitchen postern" is door between kitchen and gap_far.
  Passage gorge_path "the scramble down into the gorge" is climb between gap_far and gorge taking 30 minutes needing climbing or rope.
  Passage beacon_chain "the beacon chain" is climb between shoulder and lantern taking 1 hour hidden until chain_known needing climbing or rope.
  Passage well "the court well" is shaft between court and cistern needing rope or climbing.
  Passage wick_stair "the Lamplighters' stair" is stair between chapter_house and stair_foot hidden until wick_stair_known.
  Passage works_arch "the arch to the lamp-works" is arch between stair_foot and lamp_works.
  Passage cistern_walk "the cistern walk" is passage between stair_foot and cistern.
  Passage glass_door "the glass-house door" is doorway between lamp_works and glasshouse.
  Passage cellar_steps "the cellar steps" is steps between lamp_works and bottle_cellar.
  Passage flue "the furnace flue" is crawl between glasshouse and court hidden until flue_known needing climbing or rope.
  Passage overflow "the cistern overflow" is culvert between cistern and gorge.
  Passage deep_stair "the deep stair" is stair between bottle_cellar and deep_cellar.
  Passage sun_door "the sun-door" is door between deep_cellar and first_vault.
  Passage crack "the crack in the deep cellar's floor" is crawl between deep_cellar and crack_foot taking 1 hour.

  // The gate passage, the guardroom and the winch room.
  Observe passage_scene at gate_passage when true "A vaulted tunnel through the gatehouse, wide enough for a cart. The vault is pierced with square holes, and the far end is closed by an iron portcullis.".
  Observe guardroom_scene at guardroom when true "Bunks, a brazier, a table scarred with knife-games, and a crossbow rack with two gaps in it.".
  Observe winch_scene at winch_room when true "A low room over the gate passage. A great windlass with a capstan bar, and in the floor a row of square holes looking down into the tunnel. A heap of round stones lies beside each.".
  Observe walk_scene at wall_walk when true "The wall walk runs along the top of the curtain wall from the gatehouse to the court, with the Gap a long way down on one side.".
  Observe gorge_scene at gorge when true "The gorge under the walls, wet and loud. Out of a culvert in the cliff above, water comes down in a thin fall.".
  Observe road_far_scene at gap_far when true "On the Skerry side the gatehouse is a blank wall with a portcullis in it. Along the cliff, under the kitchen windows, there is a small iron-bound postern, and below the road the cliff drops into a gorge.".
  Observe chain_seen at shoulder when not knows(party, chain_known) "From the shoulder you can see the top of the Lanthorn's tower across the gulf, close enough to throw a stone at, and an old chain slung between it and a ring in the rock beside you." teaches chain_known.
  Entity chain_known: fact "An old chain runs from a ring in the rock on the shoulder of Hushing Fell to the top of the Lanthorn's tower. A climber could go across it.".
  Initially Assert established(chain_known).

  Person wardens "the gate wardens" at gate_passage {
    Role "two of Ninefingers' crew, keeping the gate". Ancestry human. Calling thief. Level 1. Numbers 2.
    Called "Dace", "Lumpkin".
    Guards outer_gate. Guards far_gate.
    State watching blocking "Two of Ninefingers' men lean on the inside of the gate with crossbows, waiting for someone to tax.".
  }
  // Two crowns a head: paid at either end of the passage, the wardens open the gate and wind up the portcullis.
  Relation tollAt(group, place). Initially Assert tollAt(wardens, toll_gate). Initially Assert tollAt(wardens, gap_far).
  Action pay_toll(actor: group, site: place) "Pay the wardens the Toll, six coin" {
    Description "Two crowns a head. The wardens open the gate and let the company through the passage, and no further.".
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and tollAt(wardens, site) and able(wardens)
      and state(wardens, watching) and not tolerates(wardens, actor) and quantity(actor, gold) >= 6.
    On success { Decrease quantity(actor, gold) by 6. Increase quantity(wardens, gold) by 6. Assert tolerates(wardens, actor). }
    Result "Coins go through the grille. A bar scrapes, and the gate swings open.".
  }
  // The toll buys one passage: through the gate and out at either end.
  Relation passing(group).
  Rule toll_used when tolerates(wardens, party) and at(party, gate_passage) and not sworn(party) and not guest(party) {
    Assert passing(party).
  }
  Rule toll_spent when passing(party) and not at(party, gate_passage) { Retract passing(party). Retract tolerates(wardens, party). }
  // A visitor who asks for Ninefingers is taken up to her, and must touch nothing on the way.
  Relation guest(group).
  Action ask_audience(actor: group, site: place) "Ask the wardens for a word with Ninefingers" {
    Description "They will fetch her answer. If she will see you, they will take you up through the gatehouse and across the court to her tower.".
    Requires able(actor) and company(actor) and at(actor, site) and tollAt(wardens, site) and able(wardens)
      and state(wardens, watching) and not roused(lanthorn) and not guest(actor) and not sworn(actor) and not wanted(actor).
    Time 3.
    On success { Assert guest(actor). Assert tolerates(wardens, actor). Assert tolerates(coll, actor). Assert tolerates(crew, actor).
      Assert state(guard_lock, open). }
    Result "Dace looks you over through the grille, spits, and goes off up the stair. He is gone a long time. 'She'll see you,' he says, and unbars the gate. 'Up through the guardroom and across the court. Touch nothing. Speak when you're spoke to.'".
  }
  Rule guest_strays when guest(party) and (at(party, kitchen) or at(party, chapter_house) or at(party, lantern))
    says "'Here! Where d'you think you're going?'" {
    Retract guest(party). Retract tolerates(crew, party). Retract tolerates(wardens, party). Retract tolerates(coll, party).
    Assert roused(lanthorn).
  }
  Relation admitted(group).
  Rule guest_admitted when guest(party) and at(party, gate_passage) { Assert admitted(party). }
  Rule guest_leaves when guest(party) and admitted(party) and (at(party, toll_gate) or at(party, gap_far)) {
    Retract guest(party). Retract admitted(party). Retract tolerates(crew, party). Retract tolerates(wardens, party).
    Retract tolerates(coll, party).
  }
  Rule guest_betrays when guest(party) and roused(lanthorn) {
    Retract guest(party). Retract tolerates(crew, party). Retract tolerates(wardens, party). Retract tolerates(coll, party).
  }
  // Rob her and she remembers: the wardens shoot on sight.
  Relation wanted(group).
  Rule marked when roused(lanthorn) and not wanted(party) and not lifted(toll) { Assert wanted(party). }
  Hazard bolts "Crossbow bolts through the grille" means "Deal (1d8) physical damage to ally unless dexterity save against (13).".
  Relation shotAt(group).
  Rule shot_at when wanted(party) and at(party, ?post) and tollAt(wardens, ?post) and able(wardens) and not lifted(toll)
    and not sworn(party) and not shotAt(party) says "A crossbow bolt cracks off the stones by your feet. 'That's them!'" {
    Assert strikes(bolts, party). Assert shotAt(party).
  }
  Rule shot_reset when shotAt(party) and not at(party, toll_gate) and not at(party, gap_far) { Retract shotAt(party). }
  Thing gate_bar "the outer gate" on outer_gate is scenery {
    State barred blocking "The outer gate is shut and barred on the inside; there is a grille in it at head height.".
    State open "The outer gate stands open.".
  }
  Rule gate_opens when tolerates(wardens, party) and state(gate_bar, barred) { Assert state(gate_bar, open). }
  Rule gate_shuts when not tolerates(wardens, party) and state(gate_bar, open) and able(wardens) and not at(party, gate_passage)
    { Assert state(gate_bar, barred). }
  Thing portcullis "the far portcullis" on far_gate {
    State down blocking "The far end of the gate passage is shut by an iron portcullis, down to the stones.".
    State up "The far portcullis is wound up into its slot.".
  }
  Thing windlass "the windlass" at winch_room {
    State slack "The windlass's rope is slack, and the portcullis it works is down.".
    State wound "The windlass is wound tight and pawled.".
    Change wind "Wind up the far portcullis" from slack to wound needing brawn.
    Change let_go "Knock out the pawl and let the portcullis fall" from wound to slack.
  }
  Rule portcullis_rises when state(windlass, wound) and state(portcullis, down) { Assert state(portcullis, up). }
  Rule toll_passage when tolerates(wardens, party) and state(portcullis, down) and able(wardens) { Assert state(portcullis, up). }

    State waking "The stain in the deep cellar's air has grown back to the size of a man, and the dark around it is deepening.".
    Change scorch "Unstop the noonlight at the Unlight" from ravening to scorched consuming noonlight.
    Change scorch_again "Unstop the noonlight at the Unlight" from waking to scorched consuming noonlight.
    Change burn_out "Pour out the First Light on the Unlight" from ravening to scorched consuming first_light.
  }
  Initially Assert lightless(deep_cellar).
  // Each night the Unlight grows, and the dark spreads up through the Wick toward the crew; scorched, it shrinks and
  // starts again; only the beacon ends it.
  Measure gloom(entity).
  Initially Set gloom(unlight) to 0.
  Rule unlight_grows when untilLight(clock) == 1 and not kindled(beacon) and not state(unlight, gone) { Increase gloom(unlight) by 1. }
  Rule unlight_wakes when state(unlight, scorched) and gloom(unlight) >= 4 { Assert state(unlight, waking). Assert lightless(deep_cellar). }
  Rule unlight_ravens when state(unlight, waking) and gloom(unlight) >= 6 { Assert state(unlight, ravening). }
  Rule dark_cellar when state(unlight, ravening) and gloom(unlight) >= 8 and not lightless(bottle_cellar) { Assert lightless(bottle_cellar). }
  Rule dark_works when state(unlight, ravening) and gloom(unlight) >= 12 and not lightless(lamp_works) {
    Assert lightless(lamp_works). Assert lightless(glasshouse).
  }
  Rule dark_crossing when state(unlight, ravening) and gloom(unlight) >= 16 and not lightless(stair_foot) {
    Assert lightless(stair_foot). Assert lightless(cistern).
  }
  Rule dark_hall when state(unlight, ravening) and gloom(unlight) >= 20 and not lightless(chapter_house)
    says "The lamps in the Lanthorn go out all at once, and do not light again." { Assert lightless(chapter_house). }
  Rule dark_scorched at deep_cellar when state(unlight, scorched) and lightless(deep_cellar)
    says "Noon pours into the deep cellar. The dark screams without a sound and shrinks, and for the first time in a hundred years the walls are seen." {
    Set gloom(unlight) to 0. Retract lightless(deep_cellar). Retract lightless(bottle_cellar). Retract lightless(lamp_works).
    Retract lightless(glasshouse). Retract lightless(stair_foot). Retract lightless(cistern). Retract lightless(chapter_house).
  }
  Rule unlight_ends when kindled(beacon) and not state(unlight, gone) { Assert state(unlight, gone). }
  Rule crew_quit when lightless(chapter_house) and able(ninefingers) and not lifted(toll)
    says "Ninefingers' crew come out of the chapter house in the dark, running, with their torches dead in their hands, and do not stop at the gate." {
    Assert at(ninefingers, south). Assert at(crew, south). Assert at(wardens, south). Assert at(coll, south). Assert at(carters, south).
    Assert lifted(toll). Assert state(portcullis, up).
  }
  Observe lamps_gutter at lamps when gloom(unlight) >= 8 and state(unlight, ravening) "The lamps in the great iron wheel burn low and blue, and three have gone out that nobody can relight.".
  Observe lamps_steady at lamps when kindled(beacon) "Every lamp in the temple burns tall and steady, and Mother Ash has taken to humming.".
  Observe skerry_robbed at home_town when plundered(home_town) "Doors in Skerry hang off their hinges, and the mine's meal store stands empty: Ninefingers' crew came down and took it.".
  Observe toll_gone at home_town when lifted(toll) "Carts come down into Skerry from the Gap with grain on them, and people stand in the street to watch them come.".

  Person glooms "the glooms" at deep_cellar {
    Role "hound-shaped pieces of the dark". Species cave_hound. Numbers 3.
    State prowling "Something keeps just beyond the edge of the light: three shapes like hounds cut out of the dark.".
  }
  Rule glooms_hunt when together(glooms, party) and benighted(party) and able(glooms) and not routed(glooms)
    says "The dark comes at you on all sides, with teeth." { Assert assails(glooms, party). }
  Rule glooms_shy when together(glooms, party) and not benighted(party) and able(glooms) and capable(party, sunlight)
    says "The glooms flinch from the noonlight and pour away down the crack like spilled ink." { Assert at(glooms, crack_foot). }
  Thing sun_lock "the sun-door's lock" on sun_door {
    State sealed blocking "The sun-door is a disc of bronze with no handle and no keyhole, only a hollow in the middle the size of a jar's mouth.".
    State open "The sun-door has rolled aside into the wall.".
    Change open "Hold noonlight to the hollow in the sun-door" from sealed to open needing sunlight.
  }
  Item first "the First Light" is first_light at first_vault.
  Goal lifted(toll) or kindled(beacon).
}
